title: 12 Best Late Night Eats in Tokyo
description: Discover Tokyo's best late-night eats, from iconic ramen and izakayas to unique local spots. Find 24/7 options, budget-friendly picks, and unforgettable culinary experiences.

places.name: Ichiran Ramen (Shinjuku Central East Exit)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Classic Tonkotsu Ramen with a side of Kaedama (noodle refill) and a Soft Boiled Egg.

places.name: TsuruTonTan Roppongi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their signature udon bowls, like the Creamy Carbonara Udon or the Sukiyaki-style Udon, served in their signature large bowl.

places.name: Torikizoku (Shibuya Dogenzaka)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Momo Kizoku-yaki (large chicken thigh skewer), Tsukune (chicken meatballs), and their signature Kimo (chicken liver).

places.name: Afuri Ramen Ebisu
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Yuzu Shio Ramen, opting for 'tanrei' (clear) or 'kotteri' (richer) broth, and try their grilled Chashu pork.

places.name: Gonpachi Nishi-Azabu
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Assortment of Yakitori skewers, signature Tempura Moriawase, and a generous carafe of sake.

places.name: Uogashi Nihon-ichi (Standing Sushi) (Shinjuku East Exit)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Chef's Omakase (chef's choice) Nigiri set, and try seasonal specialties like Uni (sea urchin) or fatty Tuna (O-toro).

places.name: Denny's Japan (Shibuya Koen Dori)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Japanese-style Hamburg Steak with a fried egg, or their classic Chicken Nanban set.

places.name: Yakiniku Like (Shinjuku West Exit)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their combo sets like the 'Belly and Harami Set,' selecting your preferred meat portion and sauce.

places.name: Sukiya (Shinjuku Kabukicho)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Classic Gyudon with a raw egg (tama-go), or a melting cheese Gyudon if you're feeling adventurous.

places.name: Kagurazaka Saryo (Shibuya)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Matcha Fondue, any of their elaborate parfaits, or a hot bowl of Zenzai (sweet red bean soup with mochi).

places.name: Gyoza no Ohsho (Shinjuku Kabukicho)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A double plate of their classic Yaki Gyoza, accompanied by a bowl of Chahan (fried rice) or a plate of Mapo Tofu.

places.name: Banya (Shinjuku)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Assortment of fresh sashimi, grilled fish (yakizakana), and their seasonal vegetable dishes, paired with a local sake recommendation.
